pair: retinal pigment epithelial cell (CL:0002586) vs melanocyte (CL:0000148)
why_this_pair: the measured instance named in the brief; both are shipped dictionary classes, and the audit shows RPE is a leaf term with zero is_a descendants, so this is a SIBLING confusion pair, not a subdivision question

1_shared_support.reading: both sides are driven by the MITF/TYR-family pigment programme; the shared block is the reason a marker panel cannot separate them

2_discriminating_positive_evidence.specificity_definition: papers in the side's slice / papers corpus-wide mentioning the gene

literature_slice_asymmetry_disclosed.note: the RPE slice is far larger than the melanocyte slice, which is why an unfiltered difference is dominated by whatever the RPE literature happens to discuss; the specificity floor is what makes the two comparable, and the unfiltered counts are kept beside the filtered ones rather than dropped

3_state_programmes.cutoff: >= 0.75 of mentioning chunks in state context (Annex A7-b)

4_information_the_interface_does_not_hav.window_definition: union of the recorded top-10 gene lists of the 721 clusters
4_information_the_interface_does_not_hav.reading: a distinction whose discriminating genes do not reach the window cannot be made here; absence from the window is NOT evidence the gene or class does not exist

5_when_several_candidates_must_be_kept.note: when the top-ranking candidates carry the shared pigment block, keep them side by side; the emission has no automatic winner

6_when_abstention_is_required.rule: if the window excludes the discriminating block and no independent material exists, the correct output is the parent plus a named confusion reason, not a thinner guess

recorded_reading.reading_class: probing/regression reading on the fixed 28-volume set against a fixed reference (author labels); not validation, and the reference is not an automatic gold standard
